abstract: Lymphography was performed in 130 patients with malignant neoplasm of the testes. The patients were treated by irradiation, supplemented by chemotherapy when lymph node metastases were present. The survival rates of the various pathologic subdivisions were analyzed according to the lymphography. The following 5-year survival rates were observed: seminoma: normal lymphography 94%, pathologic lymphography 69%; teratocarcinoma: normal lymphography 86%, pathologic lymphography 14%; embryonal carcinoma: normal lymphography 64%, pathologic lymphography 33%.
abstract_ja: 精巣悪性腫瘍の130例にリンパ管造影を施行し、予後との関連を検討した。患者は照射療法で治療され、リンパ節転移を認める場合は化学療法を追加した。組織型の病理学的区分ごとの5年生存率を、リンパ管造影所見に基づいて解析した。5年生存率は次のとおりであった：セミノーマで正常リンパ管造影94%、異常リンパ管造影69%；奇形癌で86%対14%；胎児性癌で64%対33%。
